jobs.name: p1_G
jobs.prompt: A full-bleed illustration that fills the entire frame edge to edge, with no border, no margin and no paper edge. A dark oil sketch for a book plate, painted loosely on a toned ground: thick paint where the light falls, thin transparent dark glazes in the shadows, visible brush marks, a few dark drawn lines, strong chiaroscuro, realistic proportions, grim and serious. Night, long ago. Seen from high on the rim of a vast deep cut in a hillside, looking steeply down into it. In the foreground at the top of the frame, two soldiers in rust-red cloaks and dull bronze helmets, seen from behind, hold torches high. From them a long column of soldiers with torches winds down a narrow path along the cut's steep wall, the figures growing smaller and smaller as they go down into the dark; one carries a standard on a pole. Far below, at the very bottom of the cut, half buried in the earth, lies one pale curve of something enormous: a low smooth hump the color of old bone, ridged with great ribs, larger than the cut itself, dim in the darkness; nothing else of it is visible. Torch smoke drifts and sparks fall into the dark. The orange torchlight is the only strong color; everything else is night.

jobs.name: p4_G
jobs.prompt: A full-bleed illustration that fills the entire frame edge to edge, with no border, no margin and no paper edge. A dark oil sketch for a book plate, painted loosely on a toned ground: thick paint where the light falls, thin transparent dark glazes in the shadows, visible brush marks, a few dark drawn lines, strong chiaroscuro, realistic proportions, grim and serious. Night, hard frost on a field beside a road. In the middle of the picture a dead man stands upright on his feet, slack, his arms hanging at his sides, his head tilted, his face empty and slack with the mouth hanging open; a villager long dead, in a torn linen shirt and wool breeches, his skin gray; a dull orange glow shines out from inside him through his open mouth, his empty eye sockets and the wounds in his chest. To the right an old watchman with a gray beard, in a slate blue-gray hooded cloak over mail, a round wooden shield on his left arm and a small lamp on his belt, lunges at him and drives a long spear into the standing dead man's chest; from the wound the orange light pours out and falls onto the frost as a scatter of small glowing orange stones. Behind them another body lies dark on the frost. The watchman's breath smokes in the cold. The orange light is the only strong color; the rest is cold night and frost, slate and gray.

jobs.name: p9_G
jobs.prompt: A full-bleed illustration that fills the entire frame edge to edge, with no border, no margin and no paper edge. A dark oil sketch for a book plate, painted loosely on a toned ground: thick paint where the light falls, thin transparent dark glazes in the shadows, visible brush marks, a few dark drawn lines, strong chiaroscuro, realistic proportions, grim and serious. Dusk, the last light: a deep blue sky over a dull rose band low on the horizon. A small camp beside a dirt road: a campfire burning high in the middle distance, a log, a bedroll unrolled with its blanket still folded on it, a pack. In the right foreground a lone traveler sits on the log facing the fire, seen three-quarters from behind: we see the back of a long hooded coat of dark weathered wool and the deep hood up, the head hidden inside it; the traveler holds up a folded letter to the firelight, a small flask on a cord wound round one gloved wrist. The traveler is a dark shape against the fire. The road runs on past the fire into the distance, where the tiny warm lamps of a waystation sit far up the road, one lamp higher than the rest. Low among the dark trees to the right, by unseen water, three small points of cold pale-blue light. The firelight is warm orange-gold; the dark around it is blue.
